site.title: Vineyard Vista Properties | Private Guest Guide
site.description: Vineyard Vista Properties private guest guide for Martha's Vineyard.
site.heroText: A thoughtful guide to the house, Edgartown, and a few of our favorite places on Martha's Vineyard.

house.title: The House
notes: No smoking or vaping anywhere on the property.
Only registered guests may stay overnight.
Please rinse beach sand outdoors before coming inside.
Close and secure windows and doors when leaving the house.

places.name: Behind the Bookstore
places.description: Courtyard coffee, breakfast, lunch, and an easy morning stop just off Main Street.

places.name: Rosewater Market
places.description: Coffee, breakfast, prepared food, baked goods, specialty groceries, and gifts.

places.name: Espresso Love
places.description: Specialty coffee, pastries, breakfast sandwiches, salads, and lunch near Main Street.

places.name: Stop & Shop
places.description: The practical choice for a full grocery run, household staples, produce, pantry items, and everyday necessities.

places.name: Edgartown Meat & Fish Market
places.description: Butcher-cut meats, fresh seafood, prepared foods, gourmet groceries, and excellent grilling provisions.

places.name: Katama General Store
places.description: Prepared food, picnic provisions, drinks, and beach-day essentials on the way to South Beach.

places.name: Rosewater Spirits
places.description: Our pick for wine, plus a thoughtful selection of spirits, beer, cocktail ingredients, and entertaining provisions.

places.name: Big Ed's General Store
places.description: A convenient stop across from Stop & Shop for liquor, beer, mixers, snacks, and other last-minute essentials.
places.address: Upper Main St, Edgartown · across from Stop & Shop

places.name: Bettini
places.description: Polished waterfront dining at Harbor View Hotel with a refined menu and a classic Edgartown setting.

places.name: l'étoile
places.description: An intimate Edgartown favorite for a special dinner in a historic house just beyond the center of town.

places.name: Alchemy
places.description: A longstanding Main Street favorite for dinner and cocktails with a lively but polished atmosphere.

places.name: Atlantic Fish & Chop House
places.description: Waterfront dining at the foot of Main Street with harbor views and a livelier evening scene.

places.name: South Beach
places.description: Wide Atlantic shoreline and rolling surf. Best for a full beach setup and a classic Katama beach day.

places.name: Bend-in-the-Road Beach
places.description: Calmer water along Joseph Sylvia State Beach with convenient bike-trail access and an easier setup for families.

places.name: Lighthouse Beach
places.description: A scenic harbor beach within walking distance of town. Ideal for a shorter outing, picnic, or sunset stop.

places.name: Steamship Authority
places.description: Vehicle travel on the Woods Hole–Martha's Vineyard route requires a reservation. Passenger reservations are not required on the traditional Vineyard ferries.
places.note: Year-round Vineyard Haven service; seasonal Oak Bluffs service.

places.name: Adam Cab
places.description: Island-wide taxi service for the airport, ferry terminals, Edgartown, beaches, dinners, and private transportation.

places.name: Vineyard Transit Authority
places.description: The VTA provides year-round island bus service. Check the current route map and seasonal schedules before heading out.

family.title: Family, Baby & Pet Amenities
paragraphs: We're delighted to welcome guests of all ages—including our littlest visitors and four-legged family members. To help make your stay more comfortable, we've provided a selection of baby, children's, and pet items. Many are the same products our own families use and enjoy, while others have been thoughtfully added to accommodate guests.

Because every child and pet has unique needs, we ask that parents and pet owners carefully inspect all equipment before use to ensure it is appropriate, properly assembled, and in good working condition. Use of these amenities is entirely at your discretion and responsibility.

tickAwareness.title: Tick Awareness
paragraphs: Ticks are common on Martha's Vineyard, particularly in grassy and wooded areas. We recommend using repellent and doing a quick tick check after time outdoors, especially for children and pets.

help.title: We're Here to Help
paragraphs: We hope every detail of your stay exceeds your expectations. If you notice anything that is missing or not working as expected, please let us know as soon as possible. We're always happy to assist and greatly appreciate your feedback, as it helps us maintain the home and continually enhance the experience for future guests.
Thank you for choosing Vineyard Vista Properties. We hope this home becomes a place where wonderful memories are made, and we wish you a relaxing and unforgettable stay on Martha's Vineyard.
